pull.title: KAFKA-20812: Move parts of KRaftClusterTest to clients-integration-tests
pull.body:
This PR moves some tests from `KRaftClusterTest` to the
clients-integration-tests module.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>, Ming-Yen Chung
 <mingyen066@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

reviews.body: Thanks for the patch. Left a few comments.

review_comments.body: Should we rename it to `DynamicBrokerConfigTest` for consistency?
We could use the default value here, right?
BTW, I failed to get the point of this test. What is the relationship between threads and topics?
Yes. I removed the explicit override and now increase `NUM_IO_THREADS_DEFAULT` by one to ensure the thread pool is resized.

This test was added in [#15838](https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/15838) for KAFKA-16649 to ensure the broker remains responsive after resizing the I/O thread pool. Topic creation serves as the liveness check.
nit: `types = {Type.KRAFT}` is already the class-level default.
I think this scenario is already covered by `testCreatePartitions` in this class. Unless there is a specific reason to run it at 3.7-IV0 / 3.7-IV2, I'd suggest removing this one.

Could we move `KRaftClusterTest#testCreateTopicsRespectsConfiguredMaxRecordsPerBatch` here too? It only needs `serverProperties = @ClusterConfigProperty(key = KRaftConfigs.CONTROLLER_MAX_RECORDS_PER_BATCH_CONFIG, value = "10")`.

review_comments.body: nit: `brokers = 1, controllers = 1` are already the defaults (same in `CreateTopicsTest` and the new test in `DescribeFeaturesTest`).
Sure, I've also moved this test to `CreateTopicsTest` in this PR.

The original PR doesn't explain why these metadata versions were chosen. Since 3.7-IV2 introduced JBOD support in KRaft, I suspect the test was intended to cover behavior before and after that change.

I'd prefer to keep it to preserve that coverage. I've also renamed it to `testCreatePartitionsAcrossMetadataVersions` to make the version coverage clearer.

issue.body:
Follow-up to [apache/kafka#22874
(comment)](https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/22874#discussion_r4039050446)

Currently many tests running on `ClusterInstance` create topics manually
using `Admin#createTopics`. The post-creation waiting behavior is not
inconsistent. Some tests implement custom waits, some call
`.all().get()`, and others don't wait.

### Changes
This PR switch these calls to `ClusterInstance#createTopic` or
`ClusterInstance#createTopicWithAssignment`.
when the topic is for test setup and maps to one of the
helpers.

Also add a new overload of createTopicWithAssignment to convert more
tests.

I kept the original createTopics calls where the test needs the returned
topic ID

Reviewers: Ming-Yen Chung  <mingyen066@gmail.com>

Reviewers: Ken Huang <s7133700@gmail.com>
